## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or UI functionality
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or configuration changes
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: Adding or updating tests

## Checklist

- [ ] My PR targets the **`dev`** branch (not `main`).
- [ ] My branch name follows the convention: `<type>/<short-description-in-kebab-case>`.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification.
- [ ] I have run local checks and tests (`vp check`, `vp exec eslint .`, `vp test`).
- [ ] The production build succeeds (`vp run build`).
